body:
Here we are.

The decorations are put away, the songs are sung, the cookies eaten, the ball dropped and the resolutions made. Together, we look back on a year that surprised and redefined us, and forward to ward a new year with some of the same uncertainties and a whole lot of much-needed hope.

If we learned anything from 2020, it’s that how the space we live in makes us feel MATTERS.

Last year, your home became your safe space, your workplace, your school, your everything. You learned how important it is to have rooms that function well and foster connection and rest. You learned how essential the bonds you share with your little ones really are, and how they can be stretched and tested.

You learned that loving each other, and loving the space you’re in, can be enough to carry you through just about anything.

It’s a new year, and in this new year, our wish for you is a new nursery!

New levels of comfort to make every snuggle even better

New storage possibilities that make life simple and easier to manage

New lines and colors that make you feel lucky to spend time in a room you truly love

We have so many new surprises in store for you this year. In the meantime, there’s never been a better time to invest in one of our timeless, classic pieces to get a fresh start on parenting in 2021. We design every piece to be your ally – reliable, beautiful, lasting, functional, and just as invested in your little one’s safety as we know you are.

Let’s start the new year with big dreams for new nursery spaces – for design that feels just as hopeful and full of potential as the year in front of us. Whether you’re expecting a little one soon, or spent New Year’s Eve awake with your newborn, we KNOW this next year will be full of magical moments.

We can’t wait to share them with you.

What are you hoping for in 2021? Share your New Year, New Nursery wishlists with us by using the #dadadanewyear #dadadamoments #dadadamoment
